sources.zh: 标签定义来自 ASAP 论文表 1（Bu 等，NAACL 2021）；“适用”“不适用”里的标注习惯来自 ASAP 训练集 36,850 条点评的统计（tasks/asap/cues.json，括号里是训练集中含该说法的点评带这个标签的比例）。
sources.en: Definitions are from Table 1 of the ASAP paper (Bu et al., NAACL 2021). The conventions under "applies" and "does not apply" come from statistics over the 36,850 training reviews (tasks/asap/cues.json); a figure in brackets is the share of training reviews containing the phrase that carry the label.

zh: 只标点评里提到的方面，不管评价是好是坏；明说和暗示都算提到。
只标点评人对这个方面有评价的地方（好、不好，或者“还行”“一般”这样的轻微评价）。只陈述事实、没有评价的不标：例如“抽中了一张现金券”没说优惠力度如何，“提前一天预约了”没说等位怎样，“点了七个菜”没说分量。依据：ASAP 是方面情感数据集，标注时每个提到的方面都要给出正面、中性或负面。
只看被点评的这家店；点评里顺带提到的别家店不算。
一条点评通常有好几个标签（平均约 6 个），几乎都会有“口味”；没有提到任何方面时可以一个都不标。
每个标签都要能指出点评里的原话作证据。
en: Label every aspect the review mentions, whether the opinion is good or bad; explicit and implied mentions both count.

Label an aspect only where the reviewer judges it (good, bad, or mildly, such as "OK" or "average"). A plain fact with no judgement is not labelled: "won a voucher" without saying how good the offer is, "booked a day ahead" without a word on the wait, "ordered seven dishes" without a word on portions. Basis: ASAP is an aspect-sentiment dataset; every mentioned aspect was annotated with a positive, neutral or negative polarity.
Only the restaurant being reviewed counts, not other restaurants mentioned in passing.
A review usually carries several labels (about 6 on average) and almost always Food#Taste; a review that mentions no aspect gets none.
Every label needs the review's own words as evidence.

definition.zh: 菜品、饮品的味道和口感。
definition.en: How the food or drink tastes.

zh: 说到好吃、难吃、味道、口感、咸淡、鲜嫩、入味等（含“味道”的点评 99% 带此标签）。
只要评价了任何一道菜或饮品的味道就算。
en: Any comment on how a dish or drink tastes: delicious, bland, salty, tender, texture (99% of reviews with 味道).

zh: 整条点评完全没有谈吃的东西（很少见，训练集里只有 5%）。
en: The review says nothing at all about how anything tastes (rare: 5% of training reviews).

rule.zh: 夸一道菜好吃只标口味；明确说“推荐”“不推荐”“值得一试”才加推荐。
rule.en: Praising a dish is Taste only; add Recommend when the reviewer explicitly recommends or advises against it.

en: Presentation, plating, colour, shape, "looks delicate".

zh: 只说食材新鲜不算外观（含“新鲜”的点评只有 41% 带此标签）。
说餐具、店面好看属于装修。
en: Freshness alone is not appearance (41%).
Good-looking tableware or interior is Decoration.

zh: 分量、份量、量大、量足、量少、吃不完、吃不饱、够几个人吃（“分量”96%）。
en: Portion size, generous or small servings, "could not finish", "enough for three".

zh: 只列出点了几道菜、几个人吃，没有评价多少。
“店面很大”“杯子很大”说的不是菜量（含“很大”的只有 66%）。
en: Listing how many dishes were ordered, with no comment on amount.
"Big" about the room or a cup, not the food.

definition.en: Whether the food is worth recommending.

zh: 点评人明确表态推荐或不推荐菜品：特别推荐（82%）、很推荐（76%）、不推荐（84%）、推荐他家的某某（81%）。
en: The reviewer explicitly recommends, or advises against, the food: "highly recommend", "would not recommend", "I recommend their ...".

zh: 只出现“推荐”两个字不够：含“推荐”的点评只有 54% 带此标签，例如“服务员推荐的”“朋友推荐来的”“推荐菜”是别人推荐，不是点评人表态。
只夸好吃，没有推荐的话。
en: The word 推荐 alone is not enough (54%): "the waiter recommended", "a friend recommended this place", "recommended dishes" are someone else's recommendation.
"Must-order" (31%), "worth it" (38%), "will come again" (21%), "signature dish" mostly do not get the label.
Praise without a recommendation.

definition.en: How high or low the prices are.

zh: 写出具体花了多少钱并带评价。
en: Price, expensive, cheap, cost per person, affordable.
A stated amount spent with a comment on it.

zh: 只写了某道菜的标价或套餐金额，没有任何高低评价，多数不标。
en: A dish price or set-menu amount with no comment on whether it is high or low.

rule.zh: “性价比”“值不值”标性价比；同时谈到价钱高低时两个都标（含“性价比”的点评 67% 也带价格水平）。
rule.en: Value for money is Cost_effective; give both when the price level is also discussed (67% of reviews with 性价比 also carry Price#Level).

rule.zh: 团购、优惠券、打折是折扣；团购价后面评价了便宜或贵，再加价格水平。
rule.en: Group deals, coupons and discounts are Discount; add Price#Level only if the price is also judged.

definition.en: Whether the restaurant is good value for money.

zh: 性价比（96%）、划算（71%）、实惠（66%）、值这个价、物超所值、不值。
en: Value for money, "worth the price", "a good deal", "not worth it".

zh: 只说贵或便宜，没有拿价钱和东西好坏比。
en: Only cheap or expensive, with no weighing of price against quality.

definition.en: The strength of discounts and offers.

zh: 大众点评的霸王餐、免费试吃（96%）。
en: Group-buy deals, coupons, discounts, promotions, freebies.
Dianping's free trial meals (霸王餐).

zh: 只说点了“套餐”，没有提优惠（53%）。
“免费”说的是免费停车、免费茶水（51%）。
en: Only says a set menu was ordered, with no offer mentioned (53%).
"Free" about parking or tea (51%).

definition.zh: 餐厅是否在商圈、市中心附近。
definition.en: Whether the restaurant is located near downtown or a shopping area.

zh: 在某某广场（84%）、商场（77%）、百货、步行街、购物中心里或旁边，在市中心、商圈。
en: Inside or next to a named plaza, mall, department store or pedestrian street; in the city centre.

zh: 只给了路名、门牌或“在几楼”。
只说离家近、离公司近。
en: Only a street name, address or floor.
Only "near my home" or "near the office".

rule.zh: 说在商场、广场里标商圈；说地铁、公交、交通方便标交通；“市中心”常常两个都标。
rule.en: A mall or plaza is Downtown; metro, bus or "easy to get to" is Transportation; "city centre" often gets both.

definition.zh: 到餐厅的公共交通是否方便。
definition.en: How convenient it is to reach the restaurant by public transport.

zh: 交通方便或不方便（97%）、地铁（92%）、公交（94%）、离某站几分钟、打车。
en: Convenient or awkward to reach, metro, bus, minutes from a station, taxi.

zh: 只说附近有什么（含“附近”的只有 44%）。
只说停车，属于停车。
en: Only what is nearby (44%).
Only parking, which is Service#Parking.

rule.zh: 怎么到达标交通；到了以后店好不好找标是否好找。
rule.en: Getting there is Transportation; spotting the place once there is Easy_to_find.

definition.en: Whether the restaurant is easy to find.

zh: 好找（96%）、难找（87%）、不好找、位置显眼、位置偏、招牌明显、藏在巷子里。
“位置很好”多数也标（96%）。
en: Easy or hard to find, prominent or tucked away, clear signage.
"Great location" usually gets it too (96%).

zh: “位置”指座位、包间位置（含“位置”的只有 52%）。
en: 位置 meaning a seat or table (only 52% of reviews with 位置).

definition.zh: 排队等位的时间是否可以接受。
definition.en: Whether the wait for a table is acceptable.

zh: 排队（67%）、等位（70%）、取号、拿号、轮到、不用排队、人多要等、去得早没排队。
en: Queueing, waiting for a table, taking a number, "no queue".

zh: 等的是上菜，属于上菜速度（“等了”55% 标排队、48% 标上菜速度，看等的是位子还是菜）。
只说人多、生意好、很火，没有说要等位。
en: Waiting for the food is Service#Timely (等了: 55% Queue, 48% Timely; it depends on what was waited for).
Only "busy" or "popular", with no wait for a table.

rule.zh: 等位子是排队，等菜是上菜速度；两样都说到就两个都标。
rule.en: Waiting for a table is Queue, waiting for food is Timely; give both when both are described.

definition.zh: 服务人员的态度和待客。
definition.en: The attitude and hospitality of the staff.

zh: 服务（91%）、服务员（90%）、态度（99%）、热情（98%）、周到、老板人好、爱答不理、主动加水换盘。
en: Service, waiters, attitude, friendly, attentive, the owner is kind, ignored us, topped up water unasked.

zh: 只说自助点餐、扫码下单，没有评价人。
en: Only self-service ordering, with no comment on people.

rule.zh: 说上菜快慢标上菜速度；含“上菜”的点评 73% 同时带服务态度，点评里评价了服务人员就两个都标。
rule.en: Speed of serving is Timely; 73% of reviews with 上菜 also carry Hospitality, so give both when the staff are also judged.

zh: 停车（93%）、车位（98%）、停车场、好停、不好停、免费停车。
en: Parking, parking spaces, car park, easy or hard to park, free parking.

zh: 只说开车去、打车去，没有提停车。
en: Only says they drove or took a taxi, with no mention of parking.

definition.en: How long ordering and serving take.

zh: 上菜快或慢（“上菜速度”98%、“上菜很快”93%）、菜等了很久、催菜、出餐快、很快就上齐了。
en: Fast or slow serving, a long wait for the food, had to chase the kitchen, "everything arrived quickly".

zh: 只描述上了哪些菜、上菜顺序，没有说快慢（含“上菜”的只有 73%）。
等的是位子，属于排队。
en: Only which dishes arrived or in what order, with no comment on speed (73% of reviews with 上菜).
Waiting for a table, which is Queue.

definition.en: The level and style of the decoration.

zh: 装修（95%）、风格、布置、氛围（78%）、有情调、小清新、古色古香、高大上、店面简陋。
笼统地评价“环境”时标（见本标签和另外三个环境标签的边界说明）。
en: Decoration, style, layout, atmosphere, "plain little shop".
A general verdict on the surroundings (see the boundary note shared by the four Ambience labels).

zh: 只说干净不干净（属于卫生，含“环境干净”的只有 55% 带装修）。
en: Only clean or dirty, which is Sanitary (55%).

rule.zh: 数据集的习惯：笼统地说“环境很好”“环境不错”“环境一般”，没有具体指哪方面时，装修、嘈杂、空间、卫生四个标签都标（训练集里含“环境很好”的点评，这四个标签分别有 94%、92%、90%、90%）。只具体说了某一方面（“装修很有格调”“很安静”“挺宽敞”“很干净”）时只标那一方面。
rule.en: Dataset convention: a general verdict such as 环境很好 / 环境不错 / 环境一般, with nothing specific, gets all four Ambience labels (94%, 92%, 90%, 90% of training reviews with 环境很好). A specific remark (stylish decor, quiet, spacious, clean) gets only that aspect.

rule.zh: 同上：笼统评价环境时四个环境标签都标。
rule.en: Same convention: a general verdict on the surroundings gets all four Ambience labels.

rule.zh: 同上：笼统评价环境时四个环境标签都标；“环境干净”只标卫生（98%）。
rule.en: Same convention; 环境干净 ("clean surroundings") gets Sanitary only (98%).

zh: 安静（90%）、吵（86%）、嘈杂（97%）、闹哄哄、适合聊天、人声鼎沸。
笼统地评价“环境”时标（见装修的边界说明）。
en: Quiet, noisy, loud, good for a conversation.
A general verdict on the surroundings (see Decoration's boundary note).

zh: 只说人多、生意好，没有说吵不吵。
en: Only crowded or busy, with nothing about noise.

zh: 宽敞（94%）、拥挤、店面小、桌子挤、位子多、包间大小、地方不大。
笼统地评价“环境”时标（见装修的边界说明）。
en: Spacious, cramped, small shop, tables close together, plenty of seats, size of private rooms.
A general verdict on the surroundings (see Decoration's boundary note).

zh: 只说订了座位、坐在哪里（含“座位”的只有 56%）。
en: Only that a seat was booked or where they sat (56% of reviews with 座位).

zh: 干净（85%）、卫生（88%）、整洁、脏、油腻的桌子、餐具干净、有苍蝇。
笼统地评价“环境”时标（见装修的边界说明）。
en: Clean, hygienic, tidy, dirty, greasy tables, clean tableware.
A general verdict on the surroundings (see Decoration's boundary note).

zh: 说食材干净、吃着放心但没有说店里卫生，多数仍标口味而不标卫生。
en: Clean ingredients or "safe to eat" with nothing about the premises.
